title: Annual reviews must be performed on all Releasable Local Area Network (REL LAN) environments.
check_content:
Have the ISSM disclose documentation that a REL LAN review has been performed annually.

If annual reviews are not being performed, this is a finding.
fixtext: The ISSM will document REL LAN reviews being performed annually.
VulnDiscussion: The ISSM will ensure Releasable Local Area Network (REL LAN) reviews are performed annually.
